title: Locked door / key retrieval and unlock

action_beats.cause_contact_followthrough: Foot settling, reach, lever grip/turn, locked pull, shoulder/neck recoil, then pocket search.
Rigid key remains on the same palm; pocket mask reveals it; shaft rotates from hanging to lock alignment.
Wrist and ring rotate; lock releases; key returns neutral before extraction; opposite palm braces the frame.
Empty hand returns to handle; lever moves only under grip; palm slides onto the leaf as the hinge opens. Entry starts visibly.
